repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
closed := false
wait until((#Laundry_Leak).leakSensor_leakage == true)
if (closed == false) {
    closed = true
    (#Laundry_Valve).valve_close()
}
(#Mail).emailProvider_sendMail("home@example.com", "Leak", "Water leak in the laundry room")

diagnosis.summary: The JoI incorrectly executes valve.close on every period execution (60000ms). The IR specifies valve.close should happen once before the cycling email notifications. At 60000ms, JoI still executes the else branch calling valve.close, while IR only sends email. Using a persistent 'closed' flag with := initialization ensures valve.close only occurs on the first script iteration.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced phase-based if-else with persistent closed flag. Valve close now only executes when closed==false (first iteration). Email sends on every period as required by the cycle. Preserves IR timing and action ordering.
